charts.title: TOI-4438 b: orbits around TOI-4438
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-4438's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-4438 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Serrano Bell et al. 2026 (2026arXiv260713333S), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname SERRANO_BELL_ET_AL_2026): P 7.446295 d

charts.title: TOI-4438 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-4438 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (53, 79, 80) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 22233480, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 8-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 8-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
